_comment: Written 2026-09-19 BEFORE any run on these documents. Three synthetic quarterly updates from one fictional company. Each entry names two distinctive substrings, one from each document's source sentence. 'contradictions' are genuine cross-document conflicts that must stay flagged as contradictions; 'superseded' are legitimate quarter-over-quarter changes that must NOT be reported as contradictions (if flagged at all, they should be 'possibly_superseded'). Prediction written with the rule, before the run: C2 (a timeless fact, no period in either claim) will be WRONGLY downgraded to possibly_superseded by the document-period rule.

C1_restated_q1_revenue: Revenue in the first quarter was 104 million dollars
C2_dividend_history: Veltris has never paid a dividend to shareholders
Veltris has paid a quarterly dividend to shareholders every quarter since 2019

S1_headcount_q1_q2: The company ended the quarter with 1,200 employees
The company ended the quarter with 1,350 employees
S2_gross_margin_q2_q3: Gross margin was 41 percent in the quarter
Gross margin was 44 percent in the quarter

not_labelled: Other quarter-over-quarter differences (operating expenses, cash, delivery time, revenue of each quarter) are also legitimate updates; any flag on them counts as a false flag unless it is downgraded to possibly_superseded.
